craft_notes: Sthāyin: Prasāda given and returned (favour circulation). Colon→dash after thine (blossom stated, keeper released). Rejected: touching Vṛtti verb — kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Hail — by love, for men's release, he blooms, Bhava, thine —
O Keeper, sung and lauded, they yield to Śambhu: bliss in life, in lifelessness.
l4.sanskrit_cite: namo bhaktyā nṛṇāṃ muktyai bhavate bhava te 'vate smṛtyā nutyā ca dadate śambhave śaṃ bhave 'bhave

reads_against.argmap: Bow by devotion, for men's liberation: he blossoms (Vṛtti sphurate, not vocative). → He blossoms for liberation; O Bhava, protector, they give remembrance-praise: bliss everywhere.
c1_essence: Milk-sea fortune natural to the Lord alone; the blossomer gives bliss in being and non-being.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti with prasāda (grace received and returned)

l2.plain_english: Bow — by devotion, for men's liberation, he blossoms: O Bhava, to you, O Protector — by remembrance and praise they give to Śambhu: bliss in bhava, in non-bhava.
